testcase.name: X owner controls load lazily, show actual plan/personal/supporter/free capacity, and default-off blocks new registration
personal-limit and full-global-pool reasons remain distinct even while receiver provision is off
legitimate enabled fixture creates an owner-bound X target with strings and existing destinations/rules only
invalid account IDs and handles stay in the form and never create a registration
registration capacity rejection retains input and a failed refresh never exposes internal exceptions
ordinary owner editing keeps quality, allocation and subscription untouched and sends CAS with changed settings only
an owner CAS conflict retains the draft and refresh uses the latest revision without dropping notifications
default-off and missing quota keep stop/delete available and deletion requires confirmation and correct revision
an already allocated paused monitor can resume at the personal cap without needing an additional slot
quality/interval follow current paid plan even when free/supporter/special assignment changes
inactive X views do not fetch or write, and a late fetch after leaving cannot replace current owner data
rapid register clicks write once and use only the returned canonical monitor after commit
existing private monitor workspace exposes lazy X controls while guild-shared scope has no personal owner panel
a free vacancy does not mutate another assignment; owner can manually choose a later eligible pool
manual move denial keeps the selected pool and suspension visibly retains pool/personal occupation
a stale manual move retains selection and requires refreshed CAS confirmation
cadence boost consumption is separate from actual registration count and still exhausts physical personal capacity
private workspace on a guild page links to personal setup without using the guild-bound setup API
an owner selects a stored receiver explicitly for a target and multiple authors can share that receiver
binding edit preserves notifications and revision, while owner rejection retains chosen receiver
a target without a receiver remains visibly pending and a listening receiver never claims successful delivery
rollout denial blocks create and resume even against stale enabled quota and preserves stop/delete/edit
failed setup metadata blocks new receiver selection and registration without losing existing binding on ordinary edits
download builder reconstructs the exact pinned release from nine source files without a prebuilt artifact
source edits, missing input, oversized input and changed ZIP/version cannot replace the pinned release
simultaneous downloads share bounded work, later downloads revalidate and failures recover
linked source directories and linked allowlisted files are refused without packaging private targets
unauthenticated and failed sessions cannot access archive inputs or disclose session errors
authenticated ZIP response has exact bytes, safe filename and private attachment headers
unavailable or mismatched release returns an understandable private 503 without raw errors
Next file tracing and Git attributes retain exact release inputs without tracing private folders
copied standalone trace layout resolves the fixed builder and reproduces the release without artifact files
beginner setup leads with concrete steps and clearly explains manual upload, consent, sensitive data and receiver readiness
unavailable intake preserves instructions/download and own deletion but cannot select or submit a file
explicit consent gates read/validation; review exposes safe metadata only and final save does not enable monitoring
file limits, extension and strict UTF-8 failures never send data
FileReader fallback supports browser files without arrayBuffer and exposes no contents
cancel and withdrawal of consent erase selection and require selecting the file again
server validation and import errors use safe fixed messages and erase the selected secret
used/expired/replaced sessions provide a recovery path through fresh selection and session
client expiry stops the import before sending the secret a second time
duplicate import is described as already stored while identity conflicts never silently replace it
deletion asks for confirmation, uses the current revision, clears upload and explains separate X revocation
stale deletion preserves safe metadata until owner refresh and list pagination keeps existing rows
rapid validation/import clicks start each operation once
inactive views do no work and leaving during read or validation cannot restore a secret selection
a deletion response from a previous active view cannot replace a refreshed list or announce success
malformed metadata and unsafe download/scope responses are rejected without displaying server strings
dedicated setup route authenticates before rendering, keys its state to the session and links back to targets
dedicated client starts with open instructions and sends only same-origin personal API requests
automation workspace advertises the dedicated setup entry only on the personal route
supporter beta and disabled rollout block uploads while keeping owned receiver metadata and deletion available
stored receiver metadata distinguishes waiting, connecting, listening, reenrollment, stop and error without delivery claims
absent rollout and receiver state fail closed and malformed new metadata is rejected
